title: AgonyMinus
description: Adds various gimmicks and items and critters and whatnot
body:
![The text "Agony-" in blue in front of a forest background](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de284bb87ffd7ed053cdebbf49b7a6a10c4f21ea.jpeg)

The successor to my previous mod, Agony, now with less of the stuff that makes it agonizing and more of the actually enjoyable features.

This mod includes many types of blocks, tools, weapons, mobs, and biomes. Most biomes have been tweaked or overhauled in this mod to include many more features and structures.

![An assortment of various blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec634e7fd9823856d7e0c69bb4d65a1c274e2909_0.webp)

![A menu full of various types of tools and items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e80616b2496fa8b668247e4a1ea4d45af1f9e8ae.png)

![Various creatures stood together](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/40af021b27c95a9771ac47a4105058568370a338_0.webp)
